# Rosenblum Law

> Rosenblum Law is a trusted legal firm offering personal injury, estate planning, criminal defense, and family law services across New Jersey and New York.

The firm features experienced attorneys including Adam H. Rosenblum (criminal defense and traffic law), Sanford Rosenblum (personal injury and trial law), and Scott Glatstian (estate planning). Rosenblum Law provides free consultations and maintains strong community involvement through charitable partnerships.
